prompts.sky: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: seamless 360-degree equirectangular game background panorama, final target 4096x1024 pixels, exact 4:1 aspect ratio. Repaint a single continuous BLUE-HOUR sky for a beautifully remembered PS2 industrial racer. ONE lighting state across the full circumference. Entire sky is medium dark blue-grey storm cloud, softly layered, soft cloud edges, no dramatic dark half or bright half. The lower quarter contains distant chimneys, storage tanks, gantries and ONE crane as dark silhouettes. A refinery flare on one tank near horizontal center is the only warm source: SMALL orange flame in silhouette area, with very broad restrained warm reflected cloud glow spanning about 140 degrees (39 percent of width), fading exceptionally gradually on both sides into blue night. NO MOON, NO SUN, no stars, no hard light shafts, no sunset. Top 75 percent sky pixel brightness stays between roughly RGB luma 65 and 100 everywhere; no near-black cloud, no white hot cloud; maximum column sky luma / minimum <=2. Warmth changes extremely slowly horizontally, no sudden colour boundaries. Left and right edges match seamlessly with equal brightness and cloud scale. Painterly low-frequency texture, oxidised port ambience, restrained blue-grey and faint sodium amber. No text, borders or grid. Output a complete wraparound panorama, never a perspective photograph.
prompts.sky-refine: Edit this exact industrial blue-hour panorama. Preserve all silhouettes, their relative position, scale, soft clouds, single flare, no moon. Deliver a panoramic 4:1 sky. Critical fix: the cloud glow at 43%-46% of the image width has a slightly sharp warmth increase. Make ALL warm-cloud colour MUCH more subtle and broad, desaturated blue-grey with only a very faint sodium tint evenly spread over 40% of the width. No orange cloud patch around the flare. Only the tiny actual flame stays orange. No local high contrast cloud edges. The entire sky is a single continuous medium blue-grey overcast blue hour, minimum sky column brightness 65 maximum 95, warmth varies extremely gradually. Preserve painted PS2 texture and silhouette details. Left/right edges match.
prompts.ortho: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: orthographic production reference sheet for TWO small mechanical game devices to be built in Blender. A beautifully remembered PS2 industrial port racer, salvaged pump-works hardware, simple honest geometry with hand-painted weathered 1024 atlases. Wide sheet, clear separately labeled FRONT, SIDE, TOP columns and two rows: SURGE above, PHASE SHIELD below. Consistent true orthographic dimensions in all three views, no perspective; plain warm grey backdrop, no environmental scene. Each device roughly 1.7 metres tall, 1.4 metres wide, mounted on a rectangular bolted base. SURGE: squat horizontal pump turbine barrel inside a chipped olive rectangular steel crash frame; round impeller face with SIX broad blunt vanes, thick pipe union on each flank, pressure gauge, rectangular stencilled S-07 plate, exactly ONE small caged AMBER warning lamp on the top corner. PHASE SHIELD: rectangular grey-and-olive pressure-valve housing containing a circular SIX-BLADE METAL IRIS face; concentric bolted flange, thick left and right hydraulic hinge barrels, a rectangular stencilled P-12 plate, exactly ONE small caged CYAN lamp on a top corner. The iris blades are broad overlapping steel shutter plates INSIDE a housing, NEVER petals or a flower. Chipped olive/grey paint, rust bleeding from bolts, greasy seams, damp staining, clear panel repairs and human-scale stencils. Six material roles only: metal, concrete, signage, emissive, water, jungle (unused roles need not appear). No crystals, no lilac, no holograms, no clean sci-fi, no sleek spaceship gadgets. Model-friendly silhouettes; rotating impeller and opening iris pivots mechanically legible. Keep same features and dimensions across every view.
prompts.hero: Use case: precise-object-edit. Using the attached orthographic reference as the exact product design, create a TWO-PANEL hero sheet, Surge on the left and Phase Shield on the right, both complete from bolted base to single caged top lamp. Camera about 1.1 metres above floor, three-quarter front view, 50 mm lens, objects each 1.7 m tall; equal scale and generous uncluttered border. Preserve EXACT silhouettes and all mechanical details from the reference: Surge rectangular chipped olive crash frame, pump barrel, six broad impeller vanes, flank pipe unions, little pressure gauge top left, S-07 stencilled plate upper right, one amber caged lamp. Shield rectangular grey pressure-valve case, thick six-blade overlapping iris INSIDE circular bolted flange, two side hydraulic hinges, P-12 plate upper left, one cyan caged lamp. Painted PS2 industrial game asset appearance, rust bleeding, chipped paint, dirty repair seams; never clean PBR. Plain humid grey backdrop and concrete floor, soft blue-hour ambient and faint sodium side light. No scene dressing, no crystals, no petals, no extra lamps, no other objects. Preserve dimensions and construction, change only viewpoint and presentation. Label each panel in a small bottom margin SURGE / PHASE SHIELD.
prompts.ids: Use case: precise-object-edit. From the attached orthographic sheet produce a clean material-ID production pass with the SAME FRONT/SIDE/TOP viewpoints and TWO rows, exact silhouettes and parts preserved. Do not redesign. Flat solid ID colours per material ROLE with no shading: METAL steel blue #527a90 for olive frame/housings/impeller/iris/bolts/pipes/hinges, CONCRETE grey #96968b only for base slabs, SIGNAGE mustard #c8ae51 for the S-07 and P-12 stencil plates and hazard paint, EMISSIVE red #f04d49 for the ONE caged bulb on each machine (cages remain metal). Show WATER cyan and JUNGLE green as unused roles in a small six-role legend. All steel paint wear belongs to METAL, not separate materials. One consistent ID per role, preserve orthographic proportions. Plain white background, legible labels. No crystals, no petals, no added geometry.
prompts.signage: Create a square 1024x1024 hand-painted PS2 industrial SIGNAGE texture atlas. Four exact equally sized square tiles in a clean 2x2 grid, no gutters. Top left: chipped grey steel rectangular machine plate stencilled S-07 in black, four corner bolts, worn scratched paint. Top right: same worn plate labelled P-12. Bottom left: faded mustard dirty plate labelled DEVICE in condensed black stencil, small downward black chevron underneath, four bolts. Bottom right: worn diagonal black and dirty ochre hazard stripes. Orthographic flat diffuse base colour, baked grime and AO, scratches, rust flecks, sun bleach. No perspective, no directional light, no shiny reflection, no clean sci-fi, no background outside tiles. Letters legible. Texture fills entire canvas.
